story: Gary is out on Magnolia Loop with his golf cart, hoping his parade lights and speaker will pass muster, though he's learning that anything visible from the street may need Architectural Review sign-off. Donna is cheerfully hailing him as her doubles partner and steering him toward Rosa's porch for coffee and a planning session for Tuesday's match. Hal stands watchful nearby, quietly tallying the flamingos in Donna's flock against the L-02 count. Back at her house, Rosa is determinedly penciling "Coffee with Hal" in ink on an open morning this week.
events: Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street and check the tally against L-02
Rosa (rosa shift schedule): Write 'Coffee with Hal' in ink on an open morning this week

gary.thought_process: I just rolled onto Magnolia Loop with the cart wired up, lights and speaker amp tested at low volume. Donna and Hal are right here, and Donna's been encouraging about my pickleball drops. Before I run the parade lights anywhere, I should remember L-01: visible exterior cart mods need Architectural Review approval, and I haven't filed anything. Hal strikes me as a neighbor who'd know the rules, and Donna and Hal both look out for the street. Better to ask than get a violation notice. It also gives me an excuse to chat and show off the rig, which beats rattling around the house alone.

parameters.content: Afternoon, Hal, Donna. I've got the parade lights and speaker on my cart, but I'm hearing I need Architectural Review sign-off for anything visible from the street. You know how that works?

donna.thought_process: Gary just showed up and Hal is still counting my flamingos. I already told Hal there are exactly three out front, so I shouldn't repeat that. Gary is my goal: I want him as my doubles partner, and we booked Tuesday already. Rosa's porch coffee is where everyone's headed, so I can nudge Gary along and keep the pickleball momentum going. Keep it short and cheerful.

parameters.content: Gary, there's my doubles partner! Those third-shot drops of yours were gorgeous, and we're still on for Tuesday. Walk over to Rosa's porch with me for coffee and we'll plan our strategy?

hal.thought_process: Donna says exactly three flamingos out front, and I've learned to verify rather than trust. The flock is right here on Magnolia Loop, so I can count them myself against L-02. She also mentioned coffee at Rosa's, which is the place to sort out Gary's cart paperwork. Count first, then head over. Already acknowledged her invite last tick, so no need to repeat the question.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street and check the tally against L-02

rosa.thought_process: I've reread the same shift schedule for five ticks and kept telling myself to pick a slot. Time to stop planning and do it: I'll look at the per-diem shifts, ink in a morning for coffee with Hal, and save his chair. It's Monday afternoon, so a morning later this week is open. Nobody's around to talk to, and the dinner can wait until the coffee is on the calendar.

parameters.content: Write 'Coffee with Hal' in ink on an open morning this week

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
